cards.mine: Sorry to interrupt you, let me say something.

cards.en: I'm [[with you]] on most of that, but...
cards.mine: I partly agree with you, but...

cards.zh: 这个先放一放，之后再聊
cards.mine: Let's not talk about it now.
cards.note: park = 先搁置，开会时超常用

cards.zh: 这个我回头再跟你确认
cards.mine: I will confirm with you later.
I don't understand, can you say again?
cards.note: 没听清 ≠ 没听懂，别说 I don't understand

cards.en: Can we [[sync up]] on where this is at?
cards.mine: Let's align the progress.
cards.note: where this is at 很澳洲口语

us.en: Can we [[sync up]] on where we're at?

cards.mine: I'm too busy this week.

us.en: I'm [[spread a little thin]] this week.

cards.mine: I can't decide this.
I will follow this.

cards.zh: 大家都了解这个情况了吗？
cards.mine: Does everyone know this situation?
cards.note: be across sth = 了解情况，澳洲职场超常用

us.en: Is everyone [[up to speed]] on this?
us.note: be across 是澳洲说法，美国说 up to speed

cards.mine: I keep my opinion.

cards.en: Let's [[look at it from another angle]].
cards.mine: Let's think from another side.
You say first.

cards.zh: 我再核实一下，然后回复你
cards.en: Let me [[double-check]] and [[get back to you]].
cards.mine: I need to confirm again and reply you.
Let's talk privately later.
Our time is almost finished.
So, to make a summary...

cards.en: That can [[go on the back burner]].
cards.mine: This priority is not high.
cards.note: back burner = 炉子后面那个小火

cards.zh: 我觉得这个方案有点风险
cards.en: I'm [[a bit wary of]] this approach.
cards.mine: I think this plan has risk.
Who is responsible for this?
cards.note: pick up = 接手一个任务

cards.zh: 不好意思迟到了，上个会拖堂了
cards.en: Sorry I'm late, my last meeting [[ran over]].
cards.mine: Sorry, my last meeting delayed.

cards.en: Sorry, you [[dropped out]] for a sec.
cards.mine: Your network was stuck just now.

us.en: Sorry, you [[cut out]] for a sec.

cards.zh: 不好意思，我刚才静音了
cards.mine: Sorry, I closed my microphone.
Good idea, let's do like this.

cards.en: Are we all [[on the same page]]?
cards.mine: Do we reach agreement?

cards.zh: 再等一两分钟，等大家进来
cards.en: Let's [[give it a minute or two]] for people to join.
cards.mine: Let's wait for everybody to come in.
Let's follow the meeting list.

cards.en: I think we've [[gone off on a tangent]].
cards.mine: I think we are off the topic.

cards.zh: 我这边简单同步一下进展
cards.mine: I make a simple sync of the progress.
We are a little bit delayed.

cards.zh: 我们卡在另一个团队那边
cards.mine: We're stuck by another team.
I want to supplement one point.
Can you say more details?
My idea is different from yours.
Do you have free time for a few minutes?

cards.zh: 我有什么可以做得更好的吗？
cards.en: Is there anything I [[could be doing better]]?
cards.mine: What are my improvement points?
You can speak directly, no problem.

cards.zh: 我想聊聊我的职业发展
cards.en: I'd love to chat about my [[career progression]].
cards.mine: I want to discuss my career development route.

us.en: I'd love to chat about my [[career growth]].

cards.mine: I will send the meeting summary to everyone.

cards.zh: 今天提前十分钟结束吧
cards.mine: We can finish the meeting ten minutes earlier.
